stories.title: LiteForge has moved: the connection details builders need.
stories.classification: Current official documentation; testnet operational guidance
stories.dek: Zeeve endpoints replace Caldera infrastructure, but a working testnet is not proof of mainnet or the complete LTC asset route.
stories.status: Documentation checked November 13, 2026 · Testnet, not a dated launch
paragraphs: LitVM’s current network documentation says LiteForge has migrated from Caldera to Zeeve. It lists chain ID 4441 and zkLTC as the testnet gas symbol. Builders should update saved RPC, explorer and faucet references using the official configuration page rather than carrying old connection settings forward.

The practical distinction is HTTP versus WebSocket access: the Caldera WebSocket is no longer active, and the documentation directs applications to the published Zeeve HTTP endpoint until a replacement WebSocket is confirmed. A wallet connection alone does not test an application’s indexing, transaction monitoring or retry behavior.

The V2 design separates native Litecoin ownership from EVM execution and Ethereum settlement. Charms provides the intended Litecoin interoperability route, with Arbitrum infrastructure connecting Ethereum and LitVM. Testnet zkLTC is not evidence that native LTC issuance and redemption across that complete route are available.

Mainnet connection details and integration-specific security information still require official release documentation. An audit or capability of an underlying component must not be described as an audit or deployed capability of the complete LitVM system.
stories.takeaway: Treat the infrastructure migration as a concrete developer task; require separate evidence for mainnet, asset movement and integrated security.
stories.discussionPrompt: Which application checks should builders repeat after changing RPC providers?

stories.title: Inside Lite Strategy’s quarter: gains are not the same as cash.
stories.dek: A September balance-sheet snapshot distinguishes LTC holdings, option collateral, repurchases and operating cash use.
stories.status: Results published November 10 · Quarter ended September 30, 2026
paragraphs: Lite Strategy reported 751,798 LTC at September 30, valued at $50.5 million, including 64,700 LTC pledged for covered-call options. These are quarter-end figures, not today’s holdings. It reported no outstanding debt.

Its $16.0 million net income primarily reflected treasury remeasurement. The release separately reports $2.2 million of operating cash use and approximately $130,000 of covered-call premiums. An accounting gain does not establish cash generation.
The company repurchased approximately 2.2 million shares at an average $1.08 during the quarter. Comparing per-share LTC requires aligned holdings and share-count dates.
A useful dashboard separates gross LTC, pledged assets, operating cash use and outstanding shares. Option income is not risk-free interest.
stories.takeaway: Read the treasury balance beside cash flow and encumbrances, not as a standalone headline.
stories.discussionPrompt: How should investors compare dated treasury disclosures?

stories.title: cLTC on Canton: what must come after the letter of intent.
stories.dek: Luxxfolio and Greywick’s proposed liquidity relationship remains distinct from deployed reserves, redemption rights and a completed financial product.
paragraphs: Luxxfolio’s October 29 disclosure describes a letter of intent with Greywick Digital that is non-binding except for confidentiality. Proposed seed liquidity and borrowing applications require further agreements.
The model would place mined LTC into a reserve and issue cLTC one-for-one. That describes an intended design, not confirmed deposits or token issuance.

Before calling this operational liquidity, readers should look for definitive terms, reserve addresses, independent attestation, custody arrangements and redemption conditions. The late-2026 launch target remains conditional.

Tokenization adds counterparty and liquidity exposure. One-for-one backing does not guarantee market price or immediate redemption. This is a follow-up evidence checklist, not a new launch announcement.
stories.takeaway: Track the signed agreement, reserve proof and redemption terms separately from the partnership headline.
